recommendations.recommendation: Be discreet and keep your intentions and thoughts to yourself.
recommendations.rationale: Revealing one's aims gives others an advantage over you.
recommendations.argued_against: Openness that exposes one's plans and weaknesses.

recommendations.recommendation: Adapt to the times and be flexible in your dealings.
recommendations.rationale: A person who moves with circumstances avoids unnecessary conflict.

recommendations.recommendation: Choose friends and associates carefully and cultivate a good reputation.
recommendations.rationale: Reputation and associates shape how the world judges and treats you.
recommendations.argued_against: Careless association and a poor reputation.

recommendations.recommendation: Be reserved in speech and avoid talking too much.
recommendations.rationale: Excessive talk reveals too much and invites mistakes.

recommendations.recommendation: Know when to yield and do not insist on being right in every matter.
recommendations.rationale: Yielding wisely preserves goodwill and spares needless contests.

recommendations.recommendation: Cultivate good judgment and excel in your role.
recommendations.rationale: Judgment and excellence earn respect and lasting advantage.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid envy and do not parade your own achievements.
recommendations.rationale: Envy and self-display provoke resentment in others.

recommendations.recommendation: Moderate your desires and temper your appetites.
Attend to timing and appearance, knowing how you are perceived.
recommendations.rationale: Good timing and presentation increase influence over others.
recommendations.argued_against: Carelessness about timing and how one appears.
